question: Who of the following popularize folk dances 'Rai"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Sahay Pandey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gawri Lok Natya/Rai Lok Natya:

 
 
• The Bhil tribe is associated with this folk drama.
 
• This is a religious folk drama. It is staged only during the daytime.
 
• This folk drama is staged for 40 days (Bhadra month and Ashwin Krishna Navami).
 
• This folk drama is based on the story of Lord Shiva and Bhasmasur.
 
• Due to the use of Mandal and Thali in it, it is known as Rai dance.
 
• The dance which is performed to add various contexts in Gawri Lok Natya is called Gawri ki Ghai.
 
• Main characters- Jhamtya and Khatkadya.
 
• Other characters - Kan Gujri, Moyabad Khedaliya Bhoot.
 
• The oldest person among the Bhils is considered to be an incarnation of Shiva and is worshiped as Budiya Devta.
 
• Shiva is called 'Puria' in the Gavri dance__. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dance of different tribes in Rajasthan

 
 
• Bhil - Gair, Gawri (Rye), War dance, Dwichakri dance.
 
• Garasia - Walar, Lur, Kood, Mandal, Gaur, Jawara, Moriya, Rayan dances.
 
• Kathodi - Mavaliya dance, Holi dance.
